english.title: Tampering with lift / escalator / travelator etc - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without lawful authority or reasonable cause or excuse,

(A)_[tampered or interfered with]_
(B)_[misused]_

(C)_[a lift]_
(D)_[an escalator]_
(E)_[a travelator]_
(F)_[a tracked transit system]_
(G)_[a conveyor belt]_
(H)_[an airbridge]_
(I)_[mechanical, electrical or electronic apparatus]_

namely **(..SPECIFY APPARATUS..) at Liverpool John Lennon Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(c) and 3(37) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
english.pointstoprove: date and location without lawful authority or reasonable cause or excuse,tampered or interfered witha lift OR an escalator OR a travelator OR a tracked transit system OR a conveyor belt OR an airbridge OR mechanical, electrical or electronic apparatus

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Byelaw 1(3) states that the offence will not be committed by any member of a fire, police or ambulance service acting in the course of their duty or to any emergency vehicle being used by such a person.
